title: document every widget with jsdoc
body:
Some of the widgets are documented using jsdoc, some are not.

It helps quickly document in the readme all the available options.

comments.body: We might also need a way to document the data passed to the templates in a consistent way.
@pixelastic are you still working on this one? we miss some widget jsdoc
I thought I had done them all (except Stats because you were working on it).
Indeed sorry it seems like every widget is now documented.
